text:
G’mar Chatimah Tovah.

To all those observing, I wish you and yours an easy and meaningful fast. May this sacred day be a time for reflection, renewal, and hope.

Wishing you peace and a blessed Yom Kippur.

text: Energy isn’t a luxury — it’s a necessity, and Jersey families shouldn’t be punished just for keeping the lights on. We need an all-of-the-above approach to get energy prices down: more nuclear, more natural gas, and more renewables. We have to cut the red tape and make sure families aren’t getting squeezed every time they flip on a light switch.
